patch_description: This redesign separates placement into two phases: a diversified beam-search constructor generates several memory-feasible candidate layouts, then an adaptive bottleneck local-search optimizer improves the complete sorted KVPR profile. Unlike the prior version, exchanges are considered from GPUs near the bottleneck as well as the exact maximum-pressure GPU, allowing coordinated balancing improvements. The implementation keeps strict lexicographic profile improvement, preserving the primary objective of minimizing maximum KVPR while ensuring every model fits in GPU memory.
